title: Cycling induced metastable degradation in GeSe Ovonic threshold switching selector
query: ovonic threshold switch selector off-state leakage current nA half-bias endurance cycles
supports: A Ge0.6Se0.4 OTS cycled 1e6 times shows a clear off-state current increase, and its nonlinearity disappears after 1M cycles. Leakage is attributed to Ge-Ge bonds and segregation (via search snippet)

title: Ovonic threshold switch selectors with electrodes including carbon and metal (US 12,256,557)
query: ovonic threshold switch selector off-state leakage current nA half-bias endurance cycles
supports: Tungsten diffusion from the electrodes raises OTS leakage; with barrier layers, selector endurance is stated as at least 1e8 cycles (via search snippet)
